name: Coastal grandmother

influenced_by: Nancy Meyers film interiors (It's Complicated, Something's Gotta Give)

reacts_against: youth-coded fast-fashion trend cycles, romanticizing an older, unhurried, coastal-leisure life instead.

wiki_facts.key_motifs: Linen fabrics, white wine, fresh flowers, coastal decor (wicker, pottery), farmers' markets, beach houses
wiki_facts.key_colours: White, cream, beige, navy, sky blue
wiki_facts.key_values: Comfort, simple luxury, understated elegance, relaxation, mature lifestyle

findings: light — about 44% of the measured color is pale or near-white
mostly muted — about 70% of the measured color is low-saturation (greys, dusty tones)
measured.caveat: Colors measured from the Aesthetics Wiki images as photographed and displayed on screen; actual materials vary, and screen colors are approximate.
